title: WorkspaceEvent
description: One frame sent over the workspace WebSocket. Every agent action, routing decision, budget change, and handoff is one of these, appended to the hash-chained provenance log.

seq.description: Monotonic per-workspace sequence number. Ordering source for the event chain.

model.description: Model identifier the provider ran with, if known.

session_id.description: Provider session this event belongs to, if tracked.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event in this workspace's chain. Empty string for the first event.

hash.description: Hash of this event, e.g. sha256(id + prev_hash + canonical_json(payload)).

signature.description: Backend signature over the canonical event bytes. Required on every event.

payload.description: Shape depends on event_type — see README.md for the field expected per type.
